name: Memory
description: Keeps what Moss remembers for each account, recalls it for a question, remembers new facts, and sets up the model that turns text into searchable vectors. Pinning, confirming, correcting and forgetting facts, suggestions, the Memory screen and the search index jobs are not part of this package yet.

features.description: Each account's notes are split into searchable pieces and indexed every fifteen minutes, covering the private note copies Moss saves and the folder named in the account's people notes preference. The Attachments and Exports folders are never indexed. Changed files are re-indexed, deleted files are dropped, and a change of search model re-indexes everything once. A restart does not re-index. Other modules can ask for one saved note copy to be indexed sooner through the requestVaultIndex API. Search and the Memory screen are not part of this package yet.

errors.description: A note could not be indexed this time. The next scheduled run tries it again.

features.description: Sets the model that turns note text into searchable vectors. Admins save an endpoint address, a model name and an optional key. The key is sealed on save and never shown again. Note text is sent to that endpoint, and the screen says so before saving. Running the model on this device is not available yet.

errors.description: No embedding model is set up
The embedding endpoint did not return a usable answer

features.description: Finds the facts the signed-in person has saved that fit a question, best match first, each with its sources and how sure Moss is. Also lists the always-relevant facts. Recall uses the configured embedding model to match meaning, and sends the question text to that endpoint. Only the person's own facts are ever read.

errors.description: No embedding model is set up

features.description: Saves a fact, or an entity such as a person or project, for the signed-in person, with the note, chat or other source it came from. The fact is saved first. Its search vector is made afterwards using the configured embedding model, which receives the fact text. If that fails the fact stays saved and the answer says the search entry is still pending.

errors.description: memory fact requires exactly one object target
The fact is saved but its search entry is not made yet

features.description: Lets the signed-in person pin or unpin a saved fact, confirm it, correct its wording, mark it stale, expired or rejected, retire it as superseded, or delete it. Confirming a fact that disagrees with others keeps it and retires the others. Correcting saves a new confirmed fact with the same sources and retires the old one. A retired fact cannot be made active again, so a new fact is needed. Facts that come from a meeting recording are not changed here.

errors.description: conflict-group memory must be resolved with confirm or correct
Cannot reactivate a superseded memory record; create a new fact instead
This recording's memory has changed or is being removed; refresh its saved state before continuing

features.description: Facts that disagree sit together in a conflict group and stay out of normal answers. Confirming or correcting one resolves the group. Deleting one leaves the group open while two or more remain, and when only one remains it becomes active again and the group is resolved.

Deleting a memory through chat always asks first. The approval card shows the memory in words, never IDs, and is good for one use. If the memory changed after the card was shown, the deletion is refused and a new request is needed. Rejecting the card tells Moss the person declined.

errors.description: The memory changed or is no longer available. Find it again and review a new request.
Memory deletion is not ready. Start a new chat and try again.

memory.recall.description: Recall source-backed graph memory owned by the active actor.

memory.remember.description: Create a source-backed graph memory fact for the active actor.

memory.forget.description: Delete one saved memory fact for the active actor. Always asks first, showing the memory in words.

settings.label: Memory search model
settings.description: The endpoint and model that turn note text into searchable vectors for every account. Note text is sent to the endpoint you choose. Running the model on this device is not available yet.
